svg.text: DIAGRAM 5 — CIATS ARCHITECTURE: Data Flows and Improvement Cycle
LOGGER — SOLE DATA INTERFACE TO CIATS
Records every event: entry, fill, exit, gate reject, reconnect, error | time_in/time_out on all WS responses (A-3) | CIATS reads only from Logger
STREAM 1 — EWMA MONITOR
288 candle evals/day (every 5-min candle)
Valid at 50 evals (~4 hours)
Detection within ~22 observations (~27 min)
THREE MONITORING SIGNALS:
(1) rejection_rate_by_regime — post_only entry quality (F6)
(2) rate_counter_by_pair — execution pressure (A-1)
(3) ws_roundtrip_latency_ms — VPS/Kraken health (A-3)
MONITORING ONLY — NEVER drives parameter changes
EWMA λ = 0.2 | signals to Proposal Engine only after 200-trade gate
STREAM 2 — TRADE OUTCOME BUS
Fires on each position close event
Captures per trade:
symbol | entry_price | exit_price | hold_duration
MAE_reached | fees_paid | exit_reason_code
asset_regime | market_regime (both tags)
signal_params_at_entry | actual_RR | P_and_L
Feeds: Statistical Engine → Proposal Engine
STATISTICAL THRESHOLDS
50 candle evals: EWMA Monitor valid. Fast warning stream active. MONITORING ONLY — not for inference.
20 trades: CUSUM SPC active. Sensitivity detection. Not for inference.
50 trades: Health check only. Detect catastrophic misalignment.
200 trades — HARD FLOOR: Inference valid. Proposal Engine activates. Half-Kelly replaces fixed 5%.
600 trades: Per-regime analysis: 100+ trades per bucket. Full regime-segmented optimization.
Rolling 200-300: Current performance window. Full corpus: zero-cost historical library.
PDCA ENGINE (Deming)
Plan: identify improvement from Proposal Engine
Do: apply change at inter-trade boundary only
Check: validate outcome vs prediction
Act: confirm, revert, or continue
Statistical methods: Mann-Whitney U, Sharpe, Spearman, CUSUM
PARAMETER STORE
CIATS writes here only | TothBot reads here only
All starting values → replaced by data after 200 trades
Half-Kelly: K% = W − (1−W)/R | apply 50% | update every 50 trades
Regime Library stores historical regime performance data
1:1.5 R:R HARDCODED — SACRED — NOT in Parameter Store
CIATS is fully asynchronous — NEVER blocks the trading critical path. Reads Logger only. Writes Parameter Store only.
